name: Place value in other bases
formula: (d_k d_{k-1} \ldots d_1 d_0)_b = d_k b^k + d_{k-1} b^{k-1} + \cdots + d_1 b + d_0, \qquad 0 \le d_i < b
whenToUse: A number is written in a base other than ten, or a problem asks which base makes a statement true.
pitfall: Every digit must be less than the base, which often limits which bases are possible. The rightmost digit is the units place, $b^0$.
